verdict.rationale: Replit's task system lets users review agent work and 'apply back to main version' before merging, and background tasks run in isolated copies (docs-39, docs-48), which implies some review/versioning workflow for agent-driven changes. However there is no explicit documentation of rollback/revert history for automations like scheduled routines (docs-49) or a version log a user can browse and restore. missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert mechanism for automations, version history UI, and independent confirmation that reviewed tasks can be undone.
